reviews.review:
[The AI–Animal Observatory](https://manifund.org/projects/aianimal-observatory), Sep 2026

I've been looking for someone to do this for a while, and I found this person from the Sentient Futures fellowship. They were recommended to me, and I worked with them on the shape of this project.

It's very important to know how the animal agriculture industry is adopting technology so we can determine if any of them are very bad and we can build solutions that are better.

I also paid back a $4000 loan so the total size of the grant is $64000
